content.title: BP’s New CEO Is an American Defender of Oil and Gas
content.summary: For years,  Meg O’Neill  clashed with environmentalists as chief executive of one of Australia’s biggest energy companies.  Now she has been tapped to lead  BP  and steer the company back to its oil-and-gas roots.  BP named the American former  Exxon Mobil  executive as its new boss in an unexpected management shake-up Wednesday.
